Job Description:

The CIO Private Bank AI Center of Excellence (AI CoE) is the core AI enablement function of Deutsche Bank's Private Bank. We enable the Private Bank business and CIOs to deliver their AI ambitions faster, more safely and at lower cost. We drive delivery across business areas, make reusability the standard and build central AI capabilities. 

We work in a forward-deployed model: AI  acceleration leads, engineers, architects and agent operators are embedded in the business and CIO streams and accelerate delivery from discovery to production. You will enable delivery across the different domains and accelerate the portfolio in progress. What we build in one domain becomes reusable components, agent patterns and shared platforms for the others.

Our focus is delivering the Private Bank AI strategy and enabling its transformation. With the business, central AI Hub and the TDI CIOs, we accelerate one AI portfolio, prioritised by value, risk and reuse. We redesign processes end to end, keeping the human decision at the core, and we make governance operational, building evaluation and control into the path to production. 


As an AI Engineer, you will design, build, deploy and operate secure, scalable AI solutions that address meaningful business needs. Combining software engineering with hands-on experience in Generative AI, large language models and agentic systems, you will work with global stakeholders to translate requirements into production-ready capabilities.

You will contribute across the full AI solution lifecycle, from discovery, experimentation and architecture through integration, evaluation, deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement. You will build reliable AI applications and services, including retrieval-augmented generation, tool use, structured outputs, multi-step and multi-agent workflows, and Model Context Protocol integrations. In a regulated environment, you will balance business value, user experience, accuracy, security, privacy, latency, cost and operational resilience, while recognizing when a simpler non-AI solution is more appropriate.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with global business and technology stakeholders to define needs, success criteria and feasible, secure, production-ready AI solutions.
  • Design and build LLM applications and AI agents using prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, tool calling, structured outputs, context management and multi-step workflows & orchestration.
  • Architect agentic and multi-agent solutions, including MCP and AI-to-AI interaction patterns, with clear responsibilities, permissions, controls and human oversight.
  • Develop maintainable APIs, microservices and event-driven integrations around AI capabilities, including authentication, authorisation, data access, caching and queueing.
  • Create data ingestion, transformation and feature-processing pipelines for structured, unstructured and real-time data, and convert experiments and models into modular production applications.
  • Build evaluation datasets and automated evaluation pipelines for quality, relevance, groundedness, robustness and safety, with measurable thresholds governing changes to prompts, models, retrieval and code.
  • Implement unit, integration, end-to-end, regression, performance and security testing, and diagnose defects across experimentation and production.
  • Apply responsible AI and security controls, including input and output validation, prompt-injection defences, safe tool permissions, privacy protection, explainability and human-in-the-loop approval.
  • Deploy, monitor and support AI services using logging, tracing, metrics, alerting, service-level objectives and incident-management practices; monitor quality, drift, failures and user feedback.
  • Optimise scalability, latency and cost through model selection and routing, caching, batching, context optimisation, efficient data processing and appropriate infrastructure choices.
  • Build and maintain cloud and container-based environments across AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform, using containers, Kubernetes and CI/CD practices.
  • Document architectures, data flows, model and prompt versions, evaluations, operational procedures, decisions and controls in line with data governance, security and risk requirements.
  • Partner with data scientists, engineers, product managers, architects and control functions; contribute to Agile delivery, code and design reviews, reusable components and mentoring.
  • Prototype rapidly, validate assumptions with users and evidence, and assess emerging capabilities such as explainable AI, federated learning and privacy-preserving techniques for practical value and risk.
  • Guide and mentor junior AI engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and innovation.

Skills 

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • A minimum of 3 years of relevant professional experience in AI engineering, generative AI, or a related role, including delivery of production systems.
  • Strong Python skills, including OOP, S.O.L.I.D. principles, data structures, algorithms, complexity analysis, packaging and maintainable application design.
  • Hands-on experience shipping LLM applications or AI agents using provider APIs or managed services such as Azure OpenAI or Microsoft Foundry, Vertex AI or Gemini, AWS Bedrock, OpenAI or Anthropic Claude.
  • Experience with vector databases, embeddings, chunking, hybrid search, rerankers, tool integration and an agent framework or SDK such as LangGraph, LangChain, Google Agent Development Kit or Dialogflow.
  • Knowledge of LLM evaluation, observability and guardrails, including evaluation datasets, automated metrics, LLM-as-judge methods, tracing, versioning and protection against prompt injection and unsafe tool use.
  • Good understanding of LLM, deep learning and reinforcement learning fundamentals, model training and validation, feature engineering, fine-tuning and model limitations.
  • Solid software engineering foundations covering APIs, microservices, distributed and event-driven systems, SQL, data pipelines, Git, automated testing and architecture principles.
  • Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins, infrastructure concepts and production monitoring.
  • Understanding of the end-to-end data lifecycle, including data quality, preprocessing, feature creation, databases, query optimisation, lineage and governance.
  • Awareness of cybersecurity, privacy, data protection, model risk and responsible AI; experience in banking, financial services or another regulated environment is an advantage.
  • Strong analytical, debugging and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess technical and business trade-offs and select AI or conventional approaches appropriately.
  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, ownership from discovery through production support, and effective collaboration in global, cross-functional and Agile teams.
  • Experience with technical documentation, user stories, acceptance criteria, code reviews and mentoring; responsible use of AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot.
  • Open-source contributions, publications, patents, research, conference presentations or demonstrable AI projects are an advantage.

Well-being & Benefits 

Emotionally and mentally balanced: We support you in dealing with life crises, maintaining stability through illness, and maintaining good mental health.  

  • Empowering managers who value your ideas and decisions. Show your positive attitude, determination, and open-mindedness.
  • A professional, passionate, and fun workplace. 
  • A modern office with fun and relaxing areas to boost creativity.  
  • Continuous learning culture with coaching and support from team experts. 
  • A culture where you can openly speak about mental health. 

Physically thriving: We support you in managing your physical health by taking appropriate preventive measures and providing a workplace that helps you thrive. For example, Private healthcare and life insurance with premium benefits for you and discounts for your loved ones, healthier ways of working and check-ups. 

Socially connected: We strongly believe in collaboration, inclusion and feeling connected to open up new perspectives and strengthen our self-confidence and well-being.  

  • 24 days holiday, loyalty days, and bank holidays (including weekdays for weekend bank holidays). 
  • Hybrid working model with 40% remote work. 
  • Options for flexible working hours. 
  • Enjoy retailer discounts, cultural and CSR activities, workshops, and more. 

Financially secure: We support you in meeting personal financial goals during your active career and for the future. 

  • Competitive income, performance-based promotions, and a sense of purpose. 
  • Meal vouchers, bonuses for referrals 

  

Interested in more: discover what our employees value in the Well-being & Benefits hub! 

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.
